requests.title: Approve compiled package v4.1 as the implementation plan for November 7
requests.question: Approve requirements-compiled/v4.1 (on top of package v4, whose verification plan it uses unchanged) as the plan the event build follows: interface contracts, file ownership, state-machine tables, GitHub error matrix, Forma layout contract, verification execution plan and schedule?
options: A: approve v4.1, after v4 is approved (ODR-V4-01)
C: decline; build from v4 alone
requests.recommendation: A. v4.1 changes no requirement, obligation or test binding (preservation-report.json); it removes decisions the team would otherwise make inside the timed window.
requests.rationale: Only the owner approves a package (RDP-003). v4.1 depends on v4: approving v4.1 without v4 leaves the requirements unfrozen.
requests.impact: Until approved, v4.1 is a CANDIDATE. The event build may follow it as guidance but must report it unapproved.

requests.title: Freeze the v4.1 interface contracts at T14, superseding FSHARP-TYPE-SHAPES sections 42 and 46 for Causa
requests.question: docs/FSHARP-TYPE-SHAPES.md section 42 (IInvestigationStore with ProviderConflict) and section 46 (LocalStore.fs) contradict ADR-R7-001 and PERSIST-003 (finding F41-01), and docs/rehearsal-007/traceability.json does not list them as superseded. Should the v4.1 contracts (IF41-STORAGE, IF41-SAVE) be the frozen Causa boundary in their place?
options: A: yes; record sections 42 and 46 as superseded for Causa
requests.recommendation: A. PERSIST-001 gives the persistence requirements precedence over older type shapes; the v4.1 contracts typecheck and implement the seven-state machine of SM-SAVE without a new state.
requests.rationale: An agent may not edit a superseded design document on its own; the contradiction must be decided.
requests.impact: With B, the interface freeze at T14 waits for the reconciliation, and the schedule gain from interface-first work is lost.

requests.title: Accept the interface-first dependency changes of the v4.1 DAG
requests.question: v4.1 lets the interface freeze (T14) and the save machine (T19) start before the domain kernel (T13), because the frozen contracts fix the types; replay verification against the real kernel moves to integration (T21). Accept this for the event schedule?
options: B: keep v4's dependencies (critical path estimated 340 minutes)
requests.recommendation: A, together with ODR-V4-07's topology choice. Under A both role-lane topologies fit the window by the estimates: A-role-lanes 405 and C-role-lanes-two-ui 345 of 420 minutes.
requests.rationale: The change moves integration risk from T19 to T21 (optimization-report.md, risks R41-02 and R41-03); the owner decides whether that trade is acceptable.
requests.impact: With B, v4.1's other artifacts still apply; only execution-dag.json and schedule.json revert to v4's dependencies.
